{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Opposition to Republican plans to endanger security with massive unilateral cuts in the U.S. arsenal.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to constructing an unproven, expensive, and ill-conceived missile defense system that would plunge the U.S. into a new arms race.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the development of technology for a limited national missile defense system that will be able to defend the U.S. against a missile attack from a state that has acquired weapons of mass destruction despite efforts to block their proliferation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A decision to deploy a national missile defense system should be made based on four criteria: the nature of the threat, the feasibility of the technology, the cost, and the overall impact on U.S. national security, including arms control.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party places a high value on ensuring that any national missile defense system is compatible with the Antiballistic Missile Treaty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for continued work in significantly reducing strategic and other nuclear weapons.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Recognition that the goal is strategic nuclear stability at progressively lower levels.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Forward Engagement requires trying to disrupt terrorist networks, even before they are ready to attack.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A need to improve coordination internationally and domestically to share intelligence and develop operational plans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A need to continue a comprehensive approach that has resulted in the development of a national counter-terrorism strategy involving all arms and levels of the U.S. government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A need to continue to target terrorist finances, break up support cells, and disrupt training.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A need to close avenues of cyber-attack by improving the security of the Internet and the computers upon which the digital economy exists.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore will tolerate no attack against American interests at home or abroad.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Terrorists must know that if they attack the U.S., the U.S. will never forget.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. will scour the world to hunt down terrorists and bring them to justice.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
